company.name: Duffel
company.shortDescription: Duffel is a travel tech company that offers API to sell travel.
company.description: Duffel provides an online platform that allows users to search, book, and manage flights from multiple airlines. It helps businesses of every size to provide flight booking experiences for their customers. The platform allows users to search for flights with real-time pricing and availability, increase revenue with ancillaries like baggage and lounge access, manage customer refunds and cancellations, and integrate with its API or ready-to-go agent booking tool.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 53.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $18,877,990 to $215,129,733, a 11.4x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
